text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after stepping out to go
shopping...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez, that shop's selection was super lousy. And none of the colors of thread they had were quite right!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I know you... from the academy!
Perfect
timing. Do you know any other
craft stores
around here? Take me there
at once!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm looking for some thread to fix a frayed spot on my hat, but I can't find anything that'll do the trick!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! The magical hat that Grandma
gave me!
C'mon, let's go already!
choice_data_list: あぁ、あの大事な帽子の……？

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. It's not like just any black will do,
you
know! It's gotta be a deeeep black
brimming with
magical power! Next!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Granny told me this brand's
thread gets
damaged wayyy too easily!
Moving on! Next!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This continues until, at long last, after
visiting
five different stores...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: This is it! This one! The color, thickness, and material are all perfect! Phew! We finally found it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, let's get stitching right away. I've
gotta
restore my hat's magical power as
soon as
possible!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is there a park or something around
here?
Let's go do it there! C'mon, take
me!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, here we go! Stitch by stitch, and
packing
plenty of magic into each one...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Poke, poke... Prick!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ow!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! This is nothing! It doesn't even
hurt
anymore! I'm gonna keep going!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh... It's still a total mess! And I've
already
resown it ten times!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: This hat can only be fixed by a witch or a magical girl! That's what Grandma told me long ago.

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
Daddy! Daddy! My hat's accessory came
off! Fix it
pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Granny
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hold on now, Sweepy. Your
daddy's about
to head off to work...
Besides, it'll take someone
who can
wield magic to fix your hat up.

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
What?! Really?! So, so... what should I
do?

text_block_list.name: Sweep's Granny
text_block_list.text:
You should fix it yourself, of course! Put
your
heart into it, one stitch at a time.
That's part of
your witch training, too,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...So, that's why I'm doing it myself. No
matter
how tough it is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm guessing the reason Sweep Tosho's

grandmother encouraged her in that
manner was
so she would become a girl
who can resolve her
own problems.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heh, of course she is! ...Anyway! I'm just
gonna
keep on sewing over and over
until my hat's nice
and pretty again!
choice_data_list: 素敵なお祖母さんだな
素敵なお祖母さんだね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, she gets back to work.
After
hearing her story, I feel like
helping her is out of
the question. I still
want to do something useful,
though...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
A video? Like on UmaTube? ...Hm. You
think
that'd help?
choice_data_list: 動画で縫い方を勉強してみたら？
あ～、魔法で早く直せたらな～！

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, here. Hmm... This is pretty
simple to
follow. So I just have to do it
like this? I see!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I, I did it! It's totally perfect!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! ♪ This stuff's a piece of cake for
Magical
Girl Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
But you did help out a little, I guess. As
thanks,
I'm gonna cast a good luck spell
on you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Phalaenopsis Orchid! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her cheerful voice echoes high up into
the blue
sky. I feel like something good
is going to come
my way!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! That's another way we could
do it! Hey,
nice idea!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'm going to use a speed-up spell!
Finish in
an instant! Alstroemeria! ☆

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! That was super impressive, right?
Okay, I'm
gonna get this finished right
away!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I-I did iiiiit!
choice_data_list: （モチベが上がったみたいでよかった）

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
My magical power must be off the
charts! I can't
believe I got it done in
one day!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You know it! And the results were
fantastic!
choice_data_list: さっきの魔法もすごかったな
さっきの魔法もすごかったね

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leaving aside the matter of whether
there was
actually any magic at work, I
head back to the
dorm together with a
delighted Sweep Tosho.
